summary: Strengthen evaluation questions, contribution analysis and evidence use in this five-day advanced M&E course. Explore the outline and enrol.
lede: Advanced monitoring and evaluation helps M&E officers, evaluation specialists and programme leads examine whether outcomes reflect programme contributions. They learn to test Theory of Change assumptions, assess indicator and data quality, and use contribution analysis to weigh evidence for and against a claim. Exercises also build mixed-method evidence tables and concise findings briefs, with limitations made clear for decision-makers.
audienceIntro: This intermediate course suits professionals who already contribute to programme monitoring or evaluation and need to investigate outcomes, judge evidence quality and present findings that inform decisions.
prerequisites: Prior experience contributing to programme monitoring, results reporting or evaluation is recommended. No coding or programming is required. Bring a laptop with Excel access for the sample-data exercise; no additional software installation is required.
